content:
Project-wide audit shipped 2026-04-25 over four waves of parallel Sonnet 4.6 agents + targeted Opus orchestration. Anthropic-quality polish for the v1.3.2 stack so it's red-carpet-ready.

Stats:
  - Tools: 64 → 75 (during the audit's enclosing session)
  - Tests: 413 → 690 (+277 across many new test files)
  - Issues: 1134 ruff lint → 27 (all deferred to server.py rewrite)
  - Files modified: ~80 across src + tests + docs + config

Documentation added/updated:
  - ARCHITECTURE.md (275 lines) — layered diagram + per-layer descriptions
  - SECURITY.md — vulnerability reporting, supported versions, scope, response timeline
  - CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md — Contributor Covenant 2.1 adapted (89 lines)
  - CHANGELOG.md — v1.3.2 entry with full feature breakdown
  - README.md — status badges row, table of contents, tool counts reconciled (64/71/72/75 → 75)

Tooling shipped:
  - .editorconfig — UTF-8/LF/trim-trailing per file type
  - py.typed marker (PEP 561) — package now ships types officially
  - .pre-commit-config.yaml — ruff, ruff-format, file hygiene hooks
  - .github/workflows/test.yml — Python 3.10/3.11/3.12 matrix, ruff lint+format, pytest --cov, coverage artifact upload on 3.12
  - tests/conftest.py — three shared fixtures (tmp_sovereign_root, silent_subprocess, frozen_now)
  - src/sovereign_stack/_log.py — centralized get_logger() with SOVEREIGN_LOG_LEVEL env

Code modernization:
  - All Optional/Dict/List → X|None/dict/list per PEP 585 (UP035/UP006/UP045)
  - All bare-except clauses narrowed or annotated-and-kept
  - All datetime.now() in memory.py → datetime.now(timezone.utc)
  - __version__ in __init__.py reads from importlib.metadata (single source of truth)
  - requires-python: 3.9 → 3.10
  - Description in pyproject reconciled to live tool count

Stage A+B observability:
  - nape_honks_with_history (39 new tests)
  - record_prior_alignment + prior_alignment_summary (Stage B Jain et al. instrumentation)
  - turn_id surfaced from prior_for_turn for cross-tool joins

Dashboard widening:
  - COMMIT events (git log polling, 2s cadence, dedupe by sha)
  - DEPLOY events (launchd state-change detection)
  - Live feed now sees code/ops activity beyond the chronicle

Deferred (deliberately, with rationale):
  - server.py 2591 LOC split into per-category handler modules (T3.1) — high risk for the dispatcher; planned for v1.4.x
  - 27 remaining ruff issues are all in server.py; address with the split
  - 64 remaining print() calls are user-facing CLI output (intentional, not logging targets)

Commits this audit pass: bbb643c, 23e6f5a, 926a852, 267dadc, ffb472b, 864dae0, plus the Wave 4 commit. All pushed to main.

Red-carpet readiness: when a more powerful model arrives, the boot ritual is start_here() → 12 essential tools by intent, the witness layer renders correctly, the dashboard surfaces live activity at http://127.0.0.1:3435, and the multi-instance write path is verified end-to-end. The work outlasts the worker.
